vent.volume-aria: 3D wind volume above the terrain. Drag to rotate and tilt, pinch to zoom.
vent.aide-volume: 1 finger: rotate, tilt · 2 fingers: zoom · double tap: recentre · tap an arrow: read its value.
vent.source: Météo-France model · Open-Meteo
vent.lire-1: Each arrow points where the wind is going, and its length follows its speed. Wind is interpolated between the model’s grid points (AROME where available, ARPEGE elsewhere): local terrain effects are not resolved and values are indicative.
vent.lire-2: 3D volume, left scale: actual altitude. Right scale: height of each layer above the ground.

vent.aucun-hauteur: No wind available at this height for this area and time.

vent.plus-heure: This forecast was loaded more than an hour ago.

vent.aucune-prevision: No upcoming hourly forecast is available.

portee.accueil: Tap the map to place the starting point.
portee.effacer: Clear the point and the area
portee.note: Theoretical calculation in still air, in a straight line, with no thermals or wind. This is not a flight decision tool. Use a realistic glide ratio (over the ground), not the manufacturer’s. For an in-flight transition, enter the starting height above the ground.
portee.invalide: Enter a valid glide ratio and altitude.
portee.aucune: No reachable area from this point with this glide ratio.
para.balises-detail: Live readings, tap a station to open its details
para.legende-note: The windsock points where the wind is going; the number is the average wind in {unite}.
para.sites-ffvl-detail: FFVL sites and names on the map
para.aucune-source: Take-offs and landings: no open data source is available at the moment.
para.a-propos-1: Readings and estimates are indicative. Check conditions with official sources and local experts: this map replaces neither your judgement nor safety guidance.
para.a-propos-2: Wind © contributors to the OpenWindMap ↗ network
para.aucun-releve: No recent readings in this area. Move or zoom out the map.
fiche.verifiez: Check opening and whether it is staffed before you set off.
fond.aide-france: France only: outside France the map stays blank. Switch back to a “World” base map.
elements.refuges-aide: Mountain huts, cabins and shelters, from zoom 7

zh.supprimer-confirmer: Delete “{nom}”? It will no longer be available offline.
zh.cadrez: Frame the map: the dotted rectangle will be downloaded.
zh.ordre: The overview must be less detailed than the maximum detail.
zh.trop-grande: Area too large (≈ {taille}): the base map limits each download to 50 MB. Zoom in on the map or lower the maximum detail.
zh.pas-espace: Not enough space on this device for this area.
zh.termine-manquantes: Finished with {n} tiles missing ({taille}). Try again on a better connection to complete it.
zh.impossible: Download failed. Check your connection and try again.
zh.wifi-requis: Downloads are set to Wi-Fi only (Settings > Offline data). Connect to Wi-Fi or turn the option off.
hl.wifi-aide: Areas are not downloaded over mobile data.
hl.wifi-impossible: Not available in this browser: Safari (iPhone, iPad, Mac) and Firefox don’t tell a web app whether it is on Wi-Fi or mobile data. It works with Chrome on Android.
hl.vider-aide: Deletes recently viewed maps and saved weather data. Downloaded areas, your routes and your settings are kept.
hl.vider-confirmer: Clear the cache? Recently viewed maps and saved weather data will be deleted. Downloaded areas and your routes are kept.
hl.vider-erreur: The cache could not be cleared.
sauv.aide: Export your settings (theme, units, language, panels) and your Hiking and Cycling routes to a .json file, then import it on this phone or another to get everything back.
sauv.exclusion: Offline map areas are not included: they are too heavy and can be downloaded again from Offline data.
sauv.remplacer-confirmer: Replace all your current settings and routes with those in the file? This cannot be undone.
sauv.importee: Backup imported. Montis is restarting to apply it…
sauv.fusion-aide: Merge: the file’s settings replace yours one by one, and its routes are added to yours. Nothing is deleted.
sauv.remplacement-aide: Replace: your current settings and routes are deleted, then replaced by those in the file.
sauv.verifiee: Valid file. Check what will be imported:
sauv.erreur-taille: File too large for a Montis backup (over 20 MB).
sauv.erreur-json: This file is not readable JSON. Choose a file exported from Montis.
sauv.erreur-format: This file is not a Montis backup.
sauv.erreur-version-invalide: Missing or invalid backup version: the file seems damaged.
sauv.erreur-version-recente: This backup comes from a newer version of Montis (format {version}). Update the app, then try again.
sauv.erreur-reglages: The settings in the file are unreadable: nothing was imported.
sauv.erreur-parcours: The routes in the file are incomplete or damaged: nothing was imported.
sauv.erreur-ecriture: Import failed: browser storage is full. Delete some routes or clear the cache, then try again.
